parts: Me a very non-salesy pitchy Facebook post that I can put into a medspa group that talks about our new Revenue leak audit tool and how we are wanting a few owners to test it out or something like that where we don't sound new, but we just have a new toy that we want to play with

Here’s a version that feels conversational, established, and curiosity-driven instead of salesy:

:::writing{variant="social_post" id="48271"}
Over the last few months, we built a really interesting internal tool for med spas called a Revenue Leak Audit.

It’s been helping us spot things owners usually can’t see from inside the day-to-day chaos. Not just leads… but gaps in memberships, packages, retention, consult flow, follow-up, client experience, underused services, referrals, rebooking, etc.

Some of the findings have honestly been kind of wild.

We’re opening it up to a handful of med spa owners right now because we want more real-world data and feedback from different types of practices before we fully roll it out.

This is not one of those “here’s a PDF and a sales pitch” things.

We actually go through your business with you and show you:
• where revenue is quietly leaking
• what’s likely costing you the most each month
• quick wins you could implement almost immediately
• and a few things you may not even realize are affecting growth

No pressure. No weird agency pitch. Just genuinely looking for a few owners who want another set of experienced eyes on their business.

If you’d want to test it out, comment below or shoot me a message 🙂
:::
